set_time_logging: set a colored time-based logging formatter with process ID, level, filename, and line number on an absl logger
set_time_logging_short: set a short colored time-based logging formatter with process ID and timestamp on an absl logger
verbose_on: enable verbose INFO-level logging across all JAX processes using absl logging
verbose_off: disable INFO and WARNING logging on non-primary JAX processes by setting verbosity to ERROR
sync_and_delay: synchronize all JAX hosts globally and apply a staggered sleep delay per process index
